title: Unit – 5 : Session – 6 : SLO – 2  |  Symbolic Limits and Series
sections: 1. lim (x→∞) 1/x = 0 — as x grows without bound, 1/x shrinks to 0. In SymPy: limit(1/x, x, oo) → 0.
2. Sum of 1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + … — a geometric series with first term a = 1 and ratio r = 1/2; sum = a/(1 − r) = 1/(1 − 1/2) = 2.
3. lim (x→0) sin(x)/x = 1 — the classic standard limit. In SymPy: limit(sin(x)/x, x, 0) → 1.
from sympy import symbols, limit, sin, oo, summation
